name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Strengthening of Central and State Regulatory Frameworks Including Technical Human Resource and Capacity Building Programs for Ayush Drugs
benefit:
> **For Ayush vertical in CDSCO:**

- **Training Support:** Training programs for capacity building are supported with a financial cap of ₹5,00,000/- per program.- **Training Support Limit:** A maximum of three training programs can be supported under this component.
> **For State Ayush Directorate / State Drug Controller of Ayush drugs:**

- **Support for Regulatory and Quality Control Activities
_eligibility_text: > **For Ayush vertical in CDSCO:** - The Ayush vertical under the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) is eligible for financial assistance under this component. > **For State Ayush Directorate / State Drug Controller of Ayush drugs:** - State Ayush Directorate / State Drug Controller of Ayush drugs are eligible. - The state should have a functional Drug Testing Laboratory and a separate functional Enforcement Mechanism for ASU&H drugs. > **Note:** Preference is given to States/UTs maintaining a database of manufacturing units and products, implementing dossier-based licensing, and conducting regular inspections as per the [Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/15278/1/drug_cosmeticsa1940-23.pdf) and Rules, 1945.
